note: Literature and disease nomenclature consistently describe intellectual disability, speech impairment, behavioral issues, and dysmorphic features as core NAV3-related phenotypes.

evidence.text: All eleven reported individuals from seven families with NAV3 pathogenic variants displayed intellectual disability along with behavioral issues, speech delay, and microcephaly.

source.title: Variants of NAV3, a neuronal morphogenesis protein, cause intellectual disability, developmental delay, and microcephaly
source.quote: All affected individuals have intellectual disability (ID), microcephaly, skeletal deformities, ocular anomalies, and behavioral issues.

evidence.text: Patients with biallelic NAV3 variants across consanguineous families consistently present with dysmorphism, intellectual disability, developmental delay, and behavioral abnormalities.

source.title: Further evidence of biallelic NAV3 variants associated with recessive neurodevelopmental disorder with dysmorphism, developmental delay, intellectual disability …
source.quote: Patients have symptoms of dysmorphism, intellectual disability, developmental delay, and behavioral abnormalities.
